title: Settings
subtitle: Your account, notifications and security.
saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.freeHint: The Free plan is enough for everyday tracking.
plan.premiumHint: You are on Premium: unlimited wallets, budgets and goals.

profile.title: Profile
profile.fullNameTooLong: Names can be up to 100 characters.
profile.emailHint: Your email is your login, so it cannot be changed here.
profile.avatarHint: Pick a ready-made picture or keep your initials. Photo upload comes later.

app.title: Language and display
app.languageHint: Changes right away and is remembered next time you log in.
app.currencyHint: SmartWallet uses Vietnamese dong for now. More currencies will come later.

period.title: Month start day
period.label: My month starts on day
period.hint: Paid on the 5th? Pick 5 and your budget period runs from the 5th of this month to the 4th of the next. You can choose 1 to 28.

notifications.title: Notification channels
notifications.hint: Choose how SmartWallet reaches you. Changes apply right away.
notifications.inAppDesc: Budget alerts pop up while you use the app. If you turn this off we still keep your notification history, it just does not pop up.
notifications.emailDesc: Also send an email when a budget is nearly used up or exceeded.
notifications.weeklySummaryDesc: A short note on Monday morning about the past week.
notifications.goalRemindersDesc: A gentle nudge when a savings goal falls behind its plan.
notifications.thresholdsDesc: By default you are told at 80% and 100% of a budget. Premium lets you pick your own thresholds per budget, right in the Budgets screen.

security.passwordHint: After you change it, your other devices are logged out to keep things safe.
security.newInvalid: The new password needs 8+ characters with a letter and a digit.
security.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
security.sameAsOld: The new password should differ from the old one.
security.wrongCurrent: The current password is not right.
security.doneHint: Your other devices were logged out.
security.unavailable: Changing the password is not available right now. Please come back later.
security.noPassword: You log in with Google, so there is no password to change.
security.sessionsHint: If you see a device you do not know, log it out and change your password.
security.revokeOthersDesc: Your other devices will be logged out. You can simply log in again on them.
security.revokeOthers: Log out of all other devices
security.revokedOthers: Logged out of your other devices
security.sessionsUnavailable: The device list is not available right now.

data.title: Delete account
data.intro: If you no longer want to use SmartWallet you can delete your account. There is no rush, and we spell out what happens before you decide.

items.data: All your wallets, transactions, budgets, goals and categories.
items.soft: Your account is hidden and logged out immediately. The data is erased for good after 30 days.
items.billing: If you are on Premium, billing stops.

data.typeInvalid: That does not match. Type your exact email or the word {{word}}.
